source.usedFor: 118 个主权国家轮廓；不使用中国、香港、澳门、台湾几何；不将属地列作国家；排除边界画法与我国立场不符的国家

processing.projection: Local equirectangular, x=(unwrapped longitude-central meridian)*cos(standard parallel), y=-latitude; uniform scale and centered padding
processing.roundingDecimals: 1; tiny rings fall back to 4 decimals if 1 decimal collapses their area
processing.contextAlignment: Province path and city highlight share the exact same projection and affine fit. Main city is separately fitted using the province projection.
processing.rings: Keep nearby islands and holes with source winding; no city/province polygons removed. Render using SVG default nonzero fill rule.
processing.remoteTerritories: France: European mainland and Corsica only. Netherlands: European part only. Ecuador: Galápagos omitted. New Zealand: main islands only (Chatham, sub-Antarctic islands and Tokelau omitted). Russia: Crimean peninsula polygon omitted. Every omitted polygon is listed per feature below; all other source polygons are retained.
processing.difficulty: Manually assigned gameplay heuristic; not an objective geographic classification
processing.distractors: City choices use stable IDs from the same province; original 60 country distractors follow the human curation table; the 2026-11-11 additions use deterministic auto-draft candidates (medium: nearest same-continent + seeded other-continent; hard: nearest overall; easy: seeded other-continent), pending playtest.
